sentences.text: Making a multi-scene AI video means the same setup, the same continuity checks, and the same exports.
Over, and over again.
Flow Auto is a Chrome and Edge extension that turns a scene-by-scene script into finished, numbered, 1080p videos on Google Flow.
Paste a ChatGPT script, or JSON.
Scenes, batches and global rules are checked before you accept them.
It makes storyboards and character sheets with Flow, ChatGPT, Grok or Meta AI, and saves them as real PNG files.
Each scene goes to Flow, in Standard or Agent mode, or to Grok Imagine, with its rules and references attached.
Flow Auto uses Google Flow's own 1080p upscale, then saves every file as 1, 2, 3, and so on, checked for the exact name and resolution.
Global rules and character descriptions go into every image and video prompt, so batches stay consistent.
The queue survives a refresh or a crash without making duplicates.
And when a result is unclear, it pauses for your choice instead of guessing.
With its own MCP server, Claude and Gemini can run it too.
Import a script, edit a scene, start or pause generation.
And it asks before anything that spends credits.
No hosted backend.
No API keys.
No analytics.
It all runs in your own signed-in browser.
Flow Auto.
A production line for AI video.
